changes_applied.note: Paraphrase. The request and the unhappy, impatient tone stay the same.

changes_applied.after_excerpt: First, I'll need to verify your identity. Could you share your email address?

changes_applied.after_excerpt: Sure, my email address is mia.garcia2723@example.com.
changes_applied.note: Small rephrase. The email value is unchanged.

changes_applied.after_excerpt: Thanks, Mia. Your account shows two orders: #W5490111 and #W7387996. Which order would you like...
changes_applied.note: Paraphrase. The same order IDs and the same question.

changes_applied.before_excerpt: I don’t remember the order numbers. Can you just check everything not associated with gaming for me?
changes_applied.after_excerpt: I can't recall the order numbers. Could you just look through everything that isn't related to gaming for me?

changes_applied.after_excerpt: Looking at your orders, these are the items that aren't related to gaming: ... Do you want to cancel or return any of these items? If so, please tell me which ones.

changes_applied.after_excerpt: All of them. Cancel or return every one of them. And be quick.
